calls.reason: The packet has no independent record of DALL-E Mini outputs for the cucumbers-and-tomatoes prompt. The spatial benchmark it found does not measure how often tomatoes were left out.

The evidence is mixed. Li et al. report entity-state representations that update, but Kim and Schuster found shortcuts in that study and say they can't tell whether tracking is truly absent. Neither study tests the June 2022 systems or settles reference.

This is a hedged forecast ('we expect') with no deadline. LongBench v2 shows long-context gains and later papers show hallucination problems continuing, but neither settles a dead end or shows the integration is absent.

No study in the packet tests whether lacking reference, cognitive models or compositionality causes bias or toxicity. The InstructGPT results concern a different intervention and don't test this mechanism.
